period: 2017 public statement; underlying reference year is not stated
source_locator: RGDA post dated 7 August 2017, paragraph beginning 'Repet cifrele'
definition: Around 6,000 employees in the Romanian game-development industry; direct association statement. The source does not say whether collaborators, freelancers, or part-time workers are included. This is an approximate public statement, not an exact annual stock.

source_locator: PDF p. 3, Executive Summary metric '6000+ employees'; the associated RGDA report page is dated 29 October 2021
definition: More than 6,000 employees in the Romanian gaming industry. RGDA says the report draws on public material, discussions, and industry-member forms and has not been audited. It does not state whether the headline includes collaborators; retain as a lower bound, not an exact 6,000 observation.

source_locator: PDF p. 13, slide headed '2021 snapshot of Romania’s video games industry' (dated October 2022): 'Employees and collaborators: 6,700'; also states +12% versus 2020
definition: Employees and collaborators in Romania's video-games industry. Collaborator legal status and the employee/collaborator split are not disclosed, so this belongs with the collaborator-inclusive series and cannot be spliced to employee-only wording.
